shadowForest.name: Shadow Forest
shadowForest.title: The Shadow Forest
shadowForest.teaser: Step into a forest where towering sentinels guard forgotten tales—shadows whisper, golden glades beckon, and the darkness cradles life like a sanctuary.
shadowForest.description: Colossal trees rise before you, like giant sentinels protecting the heart of the ancient forest. As you enter, you are embraced by deep shadows, yet their darkness inspires neither fear nor insecurity. The singing murmur of the wind among the trees seems to whisper tales of time immemorial. Sunlight, which sometimes filters through the branches and leaves, creates restful, golden clearings. The deeper you venture into the heart of the forest, the more you understand that the starkness of the great trunks surrounding you and the intensity of the enveloping darkness serve no other purpose than to protect the lives that dwell within.
shadowForest.magic: How do you live your friendship with the night? How can darkness shelter other feelings than fear?

floodedPlains.name: Flooded Plains
floodedPlains.title: The Flooded Plains
floodedPlains.teaser: The horizon swallows the earth, then your steps sink into a vast flooded plain—calm waters soothe your weary feet between islands of ancient, towering trees.
floodedPlains.description: The horizon begins to approach strangely, closer than it should. The sky seems to consume the ground, as if you were reaching the edge of the world. Then you step into the void… and realize you are standing on a vast flooded plain. Except for small islands inhabited by immense trees with massive trunks, it doesn’t seem that you’ll find any dry land anytime soon. Yet the calm water, a cubit deep, caresses your ankles and soothes your muscles, weary from the journey.
floodedPlains.magic: How do you tame the force of the cascades and learn to be fluid like rivers?

mushroomJungle.name: Mushroom Jungle
mushroomJungle.title: The Mushroom Jungle
mushroomJungle.teaser: The air thickens with choking spores among giant mushrooms. Here, even death is gentle, promising rebirth in the cycle of life.
mushroomJungle.description: A pungent odor fills the air, and the air becomes humid. Dozens, hundreds, thousands of spores invade the air as you wander among enormous mushrooms. Breathing becomes difficult. This is an impossible place for unprepared travelers. Death may come here, but it will be a gentle death, for every death here is destined to nourish the beginnings of new life.
mushroomJungle.magic: How can something that feeds on death give strength to something that is alive?

fieldSea.name: Sea of Fields
fieldSea.title: The Sea of Fields
fieldSea.teaser: The wind stirs a lullaby of grass and crickets, while an endless golden carpet unfolds beneath the sun—a land of boundless fertility.
fieldSea.description: The wind picks up and begins to blow harder. The soothing rustling of the grass mingles with the chirping of crickets in a calm melody. The sun, reflecting off the vast green field, makes you think for a moment of an endless golden carpet unfolding before you. The verdant trees, bent by the wind, and the numerous patches of wild vegetables reveal a fertile land like few others.
fieldSea.magic: How can you make the wind blow in your favor? How can the greenery help you?

silentDesert.name: Silent Desert
silentDesert.title: The Silent Desert
silentDesert.teaser: Scorching winds warp the horizon, carving red plateaus where cacti stand sentinel in absolute, sun-drenched silence.
silentDesert.description: The air begins to dry and crisp. The wind seems driven by the sun itself. The horizon distorts with the heat, while vast plateaus of reddish earth, dotted with small cylindrical cacti, populate the landscape before your eyes. You are enveloped in absolute silence and calm.
silentDesert.magic: How can silence support you and noise protect you?

titanGardens.name: Titan Gardens
titanGardens.title: The Titan Gardens
titanGardens.teaser: A blizzard of petals fills the air as colossal blooms line the path—a horizon-wide garden of lilies, sunflowers, and roses, watching over every traveler.
titanGardens.description: An avalanche of color envelops you. Petals float in the air, and the stems of giant plants line the road. A garden as vast as the horizon unfolds before you. Lilies, sunflowers, roses, daisies, and countless other dazzling blooms reach for the sky, gazing down upon every traveler who passes through their domain.
titanGardens.magic: How can fragility be strong and colors powerful?

They represent your ability to do what you want.
Whenever you need to do something that could go wrong—running, jumping, hiding, distracting, fleeing, attacking, etc.—you must use your Courage.
identity.health_tooltip:
They represent your vitality.
Whenever you find yourself in a hostile environment or facing a dangerous creature, your Soul Points will be at risk. If they reach zero, your Protector dies.
identity.honor_tooltip:
The air, waterways, creatures, and shadows perceive Honor around you. The greater your Honor, the more you are respected.
By helping others, protecting your memories, and accomplishing your mission, you will gain Honor. But beware: giving in to violence or harming a creature will cause you to lose Honor. Honor Points can be negative, and if so, your freedom to buy items or enter certain places will be limited.
identity.inspiration_tooltip:
This is your connection to the world around you.
Whenever you show creativity, help someone, or are happy with a discovery you’ve made, you can reward yourself by gaining an Inspiration Point. Be kind to yourself whenever you contribute to shaping the world around you.
identity.money_tooltip: They allow you to trade, buying or selling items.
identity.stamina_tooltip:
They represent your ability to keep going.
Your Stamina Points determine how many items you can carry or how fast the Clock advances.

faq.answer_1:
ProMe, for “**Pro**tector” and “**Me**mories” is a companion ~app~ website for “[The Protector’s Memories](https://www.criticalkit.co.uk/products/the-protectors-memories)”, a solo RPG by Enzo Salviato. It is suggested to have the app open while playing the game, as a reference and to track your progress. It is mainly for playing the game digitally (though not entirely, as using the official manual is required).

The game is exceptional, but requires taking notes on paper; something that is personally tedious for me. That’s why I developed this digital (and offline!) version, to shift the note-taking and annotation of the map onto the computer (or mobile).
faq.answer_2:
More or less the same way as the paper version of the game. On each « turn » :
1. Move on the map. Depending on your settings, the Clock advances automatically, and a new journal entry is added; otherwise, do it manually.
2. Roll a die and refer to the encounters table to determine which event occurs; you need the rulebook for this step.
3. If you can and want to collect or mine resources, refer to the gathering table and roll a die to determine what you can find.
4. Fill in your day’s adventure in the journal to make your journey canonical.
faq.answer_3: Usable? Yes. Pleasant? I’m not sure. In the same way that the paper version gives a map and character sheet in A4 format, the site is designed to be used on a computer screen that offers space and visibility. The site is technically responsive, but I don’t know if the gaming experience will be very pleasant on mobile.
faq.answer_4:
Encounters are not really implemented. The encounters table is available near the map, but it is necessary to refer to the rulebook to perform most encounters.
In addition, the stock of shops is not implemented either. This means that when creating a village, it is necessary to define the offers manually, then note them in the journal to return to them later.
faq.answer_5: The map module uses modern CSS features that are not yet well supported by all browsers. That’s why it’s best to use the Chrome browser, as it’s the one I use for development. As for why I didn’t extend support to other browsers: creating a hexagonal grid is complicated; I had to choose between using modern tech to keep things simple, or developing the entire map system with HTML Canvas, which I didn’t want to do.
faq.answer_6: For better or for worse, the game doesn’t have any concept of gender, so all characters — playable or not — are genderless. I thought it would be interesting and more immersive to have the ability to define the gender of the characters. It’s completely optional, and it’s permissive on purpose with multiple options.

context_by_rank.3: **{name} dreams of traveling to another village.** Maybe you could accompany them and learn more about their motivations and desires!
context_by_rank.4: **{name} is very ill and doesn’t have much time left.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} is {gender, select, man {alone} woman {alone} other {alone}} and no one to support them in these difficult moments. Maybe a conversation would bring some comfort? *Next time you visit this place, you’ll need to succeed a Courage test to find {gender, select, man {him} woman {her} other {them}}.*
context_by_rank.5: **{name} is seeking friendship—or maybe love?** You’re not sure, but {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} seems to feel {gender, select, man {lonely} woman {lonely} other {lonely}}. You can help them find someone who seeks something similar.
context_by_rank.6: **{name} longs for a loved one.** Maybe it’s someone who lives elsewhere or has just left. But {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} is also looking for a very special object that reminds them of this person. What is this object?
context_by_rank.7: {name} is a **cartographer**. You meet {gender, select, man {him} woman {her} other {them}} as {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} is about to leave the village and recognizes you as a traveler. {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} offers you one of their maps. Roll a D6: *Location Map (1-3)* or *Biome Map (4-6)* (see page 49).
context_by_rank.8: {name} is **painting a picture**. Realizing you’re a traveler, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} asks if you have a sketch of an unknown place, or if you can describe a panorama you’ve seen on your travels! {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} has never ventured far from their village and is seeking inspiration!
context_by_rank.9: There are rumors of mysterious Ruins scattered across the world, and **{name} is curious to learn more**. Seeing you’re a traveler, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} approaches you to see if you have any information to share!
context_by_rank.10: **{name} speaks a name while wandering the village.** Who is it? Why are they saying this name? What happened? *If you need to create a name, consult the table on page 60.*
context_by_rank.A: **{name} is mourning a recent loss.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} may have lost a pet or a close friend. Maybe a conversation would be welcome? Or perhaps {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} just needs someone to listen?
context_by_rank.J: **{name} buys objects from other parts of the world and offers 100 coins for each item of interest.** Talk to them! Maybe you have something {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} would like to acquire.
context_by_rank.Q: **{name} looks like someone you’ve met before.** Is it just an impression? You can always ask to be sure. {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} may have crossed your path before, or maybe it’s a stranger with new stories to tell!
context_by_rank.K: **{name} is a builder.** {gender, select, man {He} woman {She} other {They}} tells you that with 3 wood and 3 iron, or 1,000 coins, {gender, select, man {he} woman {she} other {they}} can build the establishment of your choice in the village.

village.title: Village Generator

J.red: **City.** It is a **large colony**. Draw **3 additional establishment cards**; if you draw a **face card** (Jack, Queen, King), **ignore it** and draw again until you get a **numbered card**.
J.black: **Wonder.** The village is **exceptionally beautiful**. Describe it. You gain **2 Inspiration Points**.

Q.red: **Fortified.** The village is **surrounded by walls** with a **guarded entrance**. You must have **at least 1 Honor Point** to enter.
Q.black: **Lush.** It features a **body of water** (river, lake, etc.) and a **garden**. You can use the **biome collection table** **without special equipment**.

K.red: **Abandoned.** The buildings seem **uninhabited**. The **establishments are inoperable** until someone decides to **rebuild the village**.
K.black: **Nomadic.** The village **moves**. When you return to this **map cell**, you must succeed a **Courage test**. On **failure**, the village **is no longer there**.

hero.eyebrow: A game companion for “The Protector’s Memories”
hero.title: ProMe
hero.tagline: Your journal, map, and toolkit for journeying through a forgotten world.
hero.sub: Free · No account required · Runs in your browser

character.title: An up-to-date character sheet
character.body: Track everything that matters — health, stamina, resources, inventory, spells — on a persistent sheet that remembers your Protector between sessions. No spreadsheets, no paper.

map.title: An interactive map at every step
map.body: Draw your journey day by day, hex by hex. Annotate your map as your adventure unfolds, marking biomes and points of interest. The world opens up as you explore.

journal.title: A canonical journal
journal.body: Write your memories in rich Markdown. Embed dice rolls, card draws, and map references directly in your entries. Your story, written in your own words.

demo.title: Day 12 — Flooded Plains
demo.content: The bridge was destroyed by the torrent.

dice.title: Built-in game tools
dice.body: Roll a six-sided die or draw from a playing card deck — all from inside the app. Results feed directly into your journal and character sheet.

music.title: Adaptive ambient sound
music.body: Soundtracks for every biome: from Shadow Forest to Flooded Plains, immerse yourself in the game’s atmosphere without leaving the app — powered by [TableTopAudio](https://tabletopaudio.com/).

demo.track_2: Flooded Plains — Spirit of the Plains

generators.title: Village and inhabitant generators
generators.body: Populate your world instantly — generate villages and their inhabitants without flipping through the rulebook. Save them to find them easily later.

final_cta.title: Ready to begin your journey?
final_cta.sub: Create your Protector and step into the world.

install_prompt.title: Install ProMe
install_prompt.description: Add ProMe to your home screen to play offline, enjoy a full-screen experience, and launch it in one tap.
install_prompt.description_ios: Tap the “Share” button then “Add to Home Screen” to play offline and launch ProMe from your home screen.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.sign_in_prompt: You can sign in to ProMe with your Google account to back up your data online. This will allow you to retrieve your characters even if you change browsers or devices. It is completely optional, and the site works entirely without a connection. Clicking the button below will redirect you to Google to sign in, then you will be redirected to the home page.
auth.sign_in_success: Sign in successful: syncing to cloud.
